svg.title: Anatomy of a scenery tile
svg.desc: A 1 by 1 degree ortho scenery tile split into layers. The DSF sits on top, then the terrain files. The terrain files reference three resources: water masks, shipped as PNG images and read from disk; ortho textures, made by XEarthLayer's ortho pipeline; and night lighting, made by its night pipeline. The ortho pipeline checks the memory and DDS disk caches, then the chunk disk cache, downloads missing chunks, assembles 256 chunks into a 4096 by 4096 image, encodes a DDS with 13 mip levels, then caches and serves it. The night pipeline checks its memory and disk caches, reads the tile's night recipe, takes lit art from your X-Plane, lights each texel by its ground position, encodes with a distance fade, then caches and serves it.
